crossRefs.note: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.
Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and…
Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to Yahweh your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go…
Moses said, “Behold, I am going out from you. I will pray to Yahweh that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh…
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who…
bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

translations.web: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: So Moses left Pharaoh’s presence and appealed to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
translations.asv: And he went out from Pharaoh, and entreated Jehovah.
